name: Túrkeve (Hungary)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the town arms of Túrkeve: a quartered blue and green shield with a church and ears of grain, with a helm, a black-winged lion crest and red and white mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Túrkeve arms with helm, crest and mantling
